symptom: The standalone v0.2 candidate preflight inspected caller-owned object descriptors and then reread semantic fields. A late own-descriptor Proxy trap could repair an invalid evidence stage or refund policy before semantic checks, making an initially invalid candidate appear complete (but never scoring-authorized).
lesson: An exported candidate validator remains a separate untrusted admission boundary even when its callers already pin inputs. Descriptor shape checks are not a substitute for a bounded detached graph before semantic validation.
guardrail: Pin the full standalone v0.2 candidate graph with the shared bounded own-data-descriptor snapshot before checking header, money, exclusions and evidence requirements. Preserve fail-closed behavior; malformed nested arrays may now reject earlier as INVALID_CANDIDATE_SHAPE. Negative Proxy tests must trigger and reject late stage and refund-policy repairs. Never infer independent evidence or scoring authorization.
